# Test Play 08

Run the offline contract validator first. When an isolated imported solution is
available, test topic routing, fallback, actions, identity, DLP, least-privilege
roles, durable approvals, audit, cancellation, error handling, and rollback.

Record the exact artifact, environment class, dataset, timestamps, sample counts,
commands, and failures. A local contract pass is not runtime or publication evidence.
